description.value:
Show me the books. I will find the clause.

Mode: Extraction and termination / drift: Sideways

Level 3: Forensic Audit

As an action, mark a target Out of Compliance for the scene; your suppression, banishment and disable effects against it reroll the lowest die. Noise +3.

Level 3: Compliance Action

Once per scene, when an Out of Compliance target violates a binding contract or precedent, force a reroll (worse result) or cost it its action. Noise +1.

Level 6: Quarantine Order

Create a controlled enforcement zone for the scene: violent escalation rolls 3d10 keep lowest 2 and manifesting inside costs more. Noise +1.

Level 10: Sanction Protocol

When a creature breaks a binding contract or major precedent: its next roll keeps the lowest 2 of 3d10, or one ability is suppressed for the round; 1 Surge escalates it against the Out of Compliance.

Level 14: Deicidal Injunction

Temporarily suspend divine or pseudo-divine authority — a god's, a thoughtform's, a mandate's granted abilities go quiet. Spend 1–2 Surge by scale. Noise +1.

Level 18: Hard Shutdown (Capstone)

End the manifestation of a feral god, tulpa or rogue divine entity. It collapses and cannot reconstitute for a meaningful time. Noise +3.
